text: 创业板指半日跌超1%，AI漫剧概念再度爆发。 恒指半日涨0.2%，恒生科技指数涨1.6%，小米集团涨超5%，美团涨超4%。 中国9月CPI同比涨幅扩大至0.9%；PPI同比涨5.0%，为2022年6月以来最大涨幅。 按美元计，中国9月出口同比增长36.3%，进口同比增长31.0%，均高于预期。 欧洲央行管委、比利时央行行长Wunsch预计欧洲央行可能不得不再次加息。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 1% in the half-day session, while the AI comic-drama concept surged again. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.2% in the half-day session, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.6%, Xiaomi Group rose more than 5%, and Meituan rose more than 4%. China's September CPI rose 0.9% year-on-year, with the increase widening; PPI rose 5.0% year-on-year, the largest increase since June 2022. In US dollar terms, China's September exports rose 36.3% year-on-year and imports rose 31.0% year-on-year, both above expectations. European Central Bank Governing Council member and Belgian central bank governor Wunsch expects the ECB may have to raise rates again.
